_comment: Production live configuration, applied at boot by
updateFromConfigurationFile() (backend/src/init/configuration.ts). The
Dockerfile copies this to /app/backend/dist/backend-configuration.json,
which is the path that function resolves.
BASE_CONFIGURATION is secure-by-default: every feature ships OFF. That is
correct for the constant, but it is not a runnable product -- with the base
values nobody can sign up and no result can be saved. This file is the
deliberate, reviewable opt-in, so the deployed behaviour lives in git
rather than in a hand-edited Mongo document.
Only keys that differ from BASE_CONFIGURATION are listed. mergeConfigurations
merges by common key and same type, so anything omitted keeps its base value.
leaderboards.weeklyXp is ON. AC-110/AC-112 make `weekly xp` one of the
three leaderboard tabs, so with it off the tab answered 503 and the page
never rendered. xpRewardBrackets stays empty on purpose: the rollover job
(backend/src/jobs/weekly-xp-leaderboard-results.ts) returns early on an
empty bracket list, so the board works and simply awards no placement
bonus - the same shape dailyLeaderboards already ships with.
expirationTimeInDays is 15, matching the >= 15 note in BASE_CONFIGURATION;
it drives the TTL index, and AC-117's `show last week` needs the previous
week to still exist, so anything <= 7 would delete the board mid-use.
Deliberately NOT enabled:
admin.endpointsEnabled  - no admin UI ships; leaving it off keeps the
admin surface unreachable in production.
results.objectHashCheckEnabled and users.lastHashesCheck - anti-cheat
hash gates (ME-175). Turning either on makes the
backend reject every result whose hash it
recomputes differently from the client, and that
round trip has no end-to-end test yet. Enable
only together with a test that submits a real
client payload. NOTE: while they are off, ME-175
is unmet and the duplicate/replay check is inert;
ME-174's task-log regeneration is the only
anti-cheat actually running in production.
users.autoBan           - only fires on ME-174 `task-log-invalid`
(result.ts). It is a *punishment* built on a
regeneration check with no production mileage,
and a false positive bans a real user. Off until
the anticheat_task_log_invalid log has been
observed to stay empty in production.
leaderboards.minTimeSpent - left at the AC-120.3 default of 7200 s.
